sources.entry: SpawnSweep - Menu bar app that shows the dev servers, simulators and build data AI coding agents leave running, and cleans up with a preview first. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/samirmaikap/spawnsweep) ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: SpawnSweep is a native SwiftUI macOS menu bar app that finds dev servers, simulators, Docker stacks and git worktrees left running by AI coding agents and cleans them up after showing a preview.
summary.what_it_does: SpawnSweep shows which AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Claude app, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Aider) still have processes running, and which localhost ports, booted simulators and emulators, Docker stacks, watchers and headless browsers they left behind. It lists git worktrees per repo with status and size, and can slim them by removing git-ignored rebuildable folders such as node_modules and dist. Removed worktrees go to a recycle bin that keeps ignored files like .env and can be restored. Autopilot rules start as dry runs, and the app keeps an activity log of changes with a way back. The menu bar shows running processes, memory used, disk free, and a button to clean up leftovers. The README says everything runs locally with no account or telemetry, and the source is MIT licensed.
use_cases: stop dev servers left running after an AI coding session
clean up unused simulators and Docker stacks
remove stale git worktrees and their build folders
see disk and memory used by agent leftovers
clean caches and large old files on a Mac (Pro)
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash (README one-line installer; URL is missing from the README text)
Or download SpawnSweep.zip from Releases and move SpawnSweep to Applications
git clone the repository (URL missing from README text)
notable: Agent-aware: labels each leftover process with the agent session that started it
Preview-first cleanup; processes are checked by start time before being signalled, stopped with TERM then KILL
Slim removes only git-ignored folders; Recycle saves non-rebuildable ignored files before removing a worktree
Built-in MCP server and Claude Code SessionEnd hook so agents can check for running dev servers
Runs locally with no account or telemetry; the only network call is a weekly Pro license check
caveats: Official download is Apple silicon only and not yet notarized by Apple, so macOS warns on first open
Junk cleaning, large and old file scanning, and some Autopilot modes are in a paid Pro tier; source builds are the free edition without Pro
Pro source code is private and not in this repository; source builds do not include Pro features
